title: Conditions: choose an action and check boundaries
goal: Explain the first matching branch from a trace and implement a new request-duration rule.

prerequisites.text: The value-types lesson: distinguish number and string. Know how to save one training handler, update your infobase and read client messages.

sections.title: Zero fits two comparisons
paragraphs: A request says 0 minutes. It needs a separate “no time spent” classification. Zero also satisfies “less than or equal to 60”. Checking short duration first would select “Short” and lose the special meaning of zero.

The previous lesson separated a value’s type from its admissibility. Here the input is already a known integer number of minutes. We need to choose an action, trace that choice, change one line, and then implement a different rule for a new request.

sections.title: State the rule first
paragraphs: The worked example accepts integer values from 0 through 1440. Values below 0 or above 1440 produce Недопустимо (invalid). Zero produces Без затрат (no time spent); 1…60 produces Короткая (short); 61…1440 produces Длинная (long). Every integer input has exactly one result.

A comparison has a Boolean result: true or false. Если tests that result. A true condition runs its statement group, and this chain does not proceed to later ИначеЕсли clauses. Иначе handles the remaining case, when no earlier check matched.
Numeric type and whole minutes are preconditions of this task. The example checks the range; it does not parse arbitrary text or validate fractional input.

sections.title: Trace the first choice for zero
paragraphs: This is the complete startup handler. Keep one such handler in your training infobase. Минуты receives 0; each branch assigns a string to Класс; one Сообщить runs after КонецЕсли.

The rejection check is false: zero is neither below zero nor above 1440. Минуты = 0 is true, so the program selects Без затрат. Inside a condition, = compares values; the statement Минуты = 0; assigns a value.

“Not evaluated” differs from false. The comparison 0 <= 60 would be true, but execution never reaches it. The output beside the program is the actual result of this complete handler in the training platform.

sections.title: Change only the input: predict first
paragraphs: Replace 0 with 61 in the first statement of the handler body. Keep the rest of the complete example. Before running it, write the expected message and the checks that the value will pass through.
Decide whether the zero check can be true and whether 61 belongs to the group through 60. Then reveal the reasoning and compare it with your trace.

reveal.title: Compare your prediction with the reasoning
paragraphs: 61 is in range, is not zero, and is not ≤60. All three checks are false, so Иначе runs and assigns Длинная.
The ≤60 comparison is actually evaluated here. For zero in the previous example, it was skipped.

sections.title: The complete program for 61 minutes
paragraphs: Run this version and compare Длинная with your prediction. Restore 0 and you will get Без затрат again. One changed input changes the route while the branch order stays the same.
Explain more than the matching word. Identify where the routes for 0 and 61 diverge: the zero check selects a branch only for the first value.

sections.title: See the route in the flowchart
paragraphs: Read the diamonds from top to bottom. A “yes” answer exits to the right and then to the common end; “no” continues to the next comparison. The diagram labels summarize the rule: Invalid means Недопустимо, No cost means Без затрат, Short means Короткая, and Long means Длинная.
Follow 0 and then 61. Once zero exits through No cost, it has no further route to ≤60. The same paths are available as plain text below the diagram.

flowchart.caption: One selected branch, then the common end
paths: −1 and 1441 make the first condition true → rejection, Недопустимо.
0 makes the first condition false and the zero check true → Без затрат. The ≤60 check is skipped.
61 and 1440 make all three checks false → Else, Длинная.

sections.title: Correct comparisons in the wrong order
paragraphs: This version swaps two checks. Range rejection is still first, but ≤60 now appears before zero. Identify the statement that will classify 0.

The training platform actually displays Короткая. The zero comparison is valid on its own, but execution never reaches it. This counterexample explains the defect more precisely than merely saying that order matters.
Restore the order in your copy and repeat 0. The independent task will also need a special zero case, with a different limit for short processing.

sections.title: И, Или and Не ask different questions
paragraphs: Rejection is required when either limit is violated: Минуты < 0 Или Минуты > 1440. For −1 the first part is true and the second is false; Или is true. For 1441 the parts are reversed, and rejection is still required.
Replacing Или with И would require both violations at once. A number cannot be below 0 and above 1440 simultaneously, so that check would stop detecting out-of-range values.

И is useful when both parts are required: Минуты >= 0 И Минуты <= 1440 describes being inside the interval. Не reverses a Boolean result; Не (Минуты >= 0 И Минуты <= 1440) describes being outside it. Parentheses preserve the intended group.
True and false in the table are logical results, rather than literal messages produced by the program.

sections.title: Check where the result changes
paragraphs: A typical value such as 30 does not expose <60 in place of ≤60. Input 60 does: the correct program prints Короткая, whereas the changed program prints Длинная. Both results were obtained in the native check.

Adjacent inputs check opposite sides of a boundary. −1/0 checks the start of the range; 0/1 checks special zero; 60/61 checks short duration; 1440/1441 checks the upper limit. Fill in your prediction before running.
For each defect, save the input and the first check that diverged. This gives you evidence for explaining your own solution.

sections.title: Where to put the complete handler
paragraphs: Nexus can display the example and hold a separate draft. Installed training 1C executes BSL. Open your separate training infobase in Designer, right-click its configuration root, and choose «Открыть модуль приложения» (Open application module).

Save the previous exercise as a separate file. The complete program above already includes Процедура and КонецПроцедуры; replace one previous training handler with it. Save with Ctrl+S, update the database configuration with F7, and start the client with F5.
The genuine screenshot shows this main0. Its editor text was checked against the complete handler. The practical steps below identify Nexus, Designer, client, and result-recording actions separately.

sections.title: A new rule for a new request
paragraphs: The rule now changes. МинутыЗаявки is a known integer number of minutes, with a valid window of 0…180. Zero means Без затрат (no time spent); 1…30 means Срочно (urgent); 31…180 means Обычно (normal); outside the window requires Ошибка (error).
Make your decision table before writing code. The starter provides 31; you write the branches. Each run must produce one message after selecting the status.
The limits 60 and 1440 belong to the worked example. This task needs a different short-duration threshold and upper limit. Save your own version before opening the reference.

sections.title: Compare the new task flowchart with yours
paragraphs: “Minutes” in this diagram means the value of МинутыЗаявки in the starter. Trace 31 first and then 0. Identify the diamond after which zero already has its exit.
Trace all seven inputs: −1, 0, 1, 30, 31, 180, 181. If your route gives zero Urgent or omits rejection for 181, correct the diagram before implementing it. Plain-text paths are available below.

flowchart.caption: New request rule: exit after the first matching branch
paths: −1 violates the lower limit → Ошибка (error); later checks are skipped.
0 is in range → zero → Без затрат (no time spent); ≤30 is not checked.
1 and 30 are valid, nonzero and ≤30 → Срочно (urgent).
31 and 180 are valid, nonzero and >30 → Обычно (normal).

sections.title: Find the first difference in the trace
paragraphs: If zero gets Срочно, check whether ≤30 appears before the separate zero case. If 30 gets Обычно, compare <30 and ≤30. If −1 or 181 is accepted as a request, inspect the connective in the rejection condition.
The deliberately wrong И version produced Срочно for −1 and Обычно for 181 in the native check. Those outputs expose a defect: the new rule requires Ошибка for both.

If no message appears, first check syntax errors, the handler name, and the database update. For a successful run, compare prediction with observation and name the first divergent check. Technical execution and your explanation are assessed separately.

sections.title: Connect the program, output and explanation
paragraphs: The complete main0 without diagnostic additions produced one Без затрат message in the training client. The complete independent reference with 31 produced one Обычно. These runs used the new sources, rather than reusing an earlier lab’s result.
The screenshot below shows the worked example with zero. For your own work, save input, prediction, actual message, and the first selected branch. Explain the matching observations in your own words.

practice.title: Request window: your own 0…180 rule
practice.task: For a known integer МинутыЗаявки, implement: 0 → Без затрат; 1…30 → Срочно; 31…180 → Обычно; outside 0…180 → Ошибка. Display one message after selecting the status. Start with 31, then independently check −1, 0, 1, 30, 180, 181. Save prediction, observation, and the reason for the first selected branch.
practice.environment: Installed training 1C:Enterprise8.3, an own separate infobase, and the application module with one ПриНачалеРаботыСистемы. Nexus holds a separate draft; 1C executes BSL.

paragraphs: Reject values outside 0…180 first. Among valid values, select zero separately, then the group through 30. Remaining values31…180 get Обычно.
For zero, execution never reaches ≤30. Или detects either range violation; И would require both violations simultaneously.

The input is assumed to be known whole minutes. This source does not parse arbitrary text or separately validate fractional values. Your trace explanation is assessed separately from matching messages.
